## 🎮 **Retro Protection Case – Game Boy Advance SP Style (Print-in-Place)**

Dive straight into 2000s nostalgia with this unique protective case, fully inspired by the legendary **Game Boy Advance SP**! Passionately designed for retro-gaming enthusiasts, this model perfectly balances a highly faithful vintage design with modern 3D printing engineering.

This project doesn’t just protect your gear—it brings the iconic console back to life with striking 3D embossed details (A/B buttons, logo, colored side stripes) that will look stunning on your desk or in your collection display.

### Retro Storage Case for Game Boy Advance – Custom Design & Print-in-Place

## ✨ Why You Should Download This Model (Key Features)

- **100% Faithful & Embossed Design:** The addition of precisely placed 3D raised elements instantly revives the signature look of our favorite childhood handheld console.
- **Print-in-Place Technology:** The case prints as a single piece, including the hinge! No complex mechanical assembly required straight off the build plate.
- **Maximum Compatibility (Perfect Fit):**
  - Tailor-made to perfectly hug the lines of the **original console**.
  - **Bonus Tolerance Added:** Specific tolerances have been engineered into the design to guarantee full compatibility with aftermarket third-party shells (generic/Chinese replacement shells), which can sometimes be slightly thicker.
- **Premium Magnetic Closure:** Pre-routed to accommodate 4 magnets, providing an incredibly satisfying and secure "click" when closing the case.

## 🛠️ Required Hardware & Assembly Tips

The model is optimized for quick and easy final assembly. To finish your case, you will simply need:

1. **4x Magnets (5x3 mm)** (to be inserted into the designated slots).
2. **Super Glue** (Cyanoacrylate).
3. _Expert Assembly Tip:_ Use a **toothpick** or a **cotton swab** to apply very tiny drops of glue. This prevents any messy overflow onto the outer surfaces, ensuring an incredibly clean, professional studio-quality finish!

## 🚀 Recommended Print Settings

- **Layer Height:** 0.16mm or 0.20mm (for crisp, sharp button details).
- **Supports:** Not required (thanks to the optimized Print-in-Place design).
- **Infill:** 10% to 15% (Gyroid or Grid).
- **Material:** PLA (for vibrant colors) or PETG (for extra durability).
